verdicts.claim: reduces texture memory and sample count by 3
verdicts.corrected: **Channel packing** is a standard production optimization — combining roughness (R), metallic (G), and AO (B) channels into a single RGB texture reduces texture sampler slots and GPU memory bandwidth relative to three separate single-channel textures (Epic Games, *Unreal Engine Materials: Texture Packing*; Khronos glTF 2.0 specification §5.22.1).
